subject: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>
Cc: Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for partnering on the “Regulated LLM Inference: Private/VPC patterns + security review shortcuts” webinar.

To keep us on track for Thu, Feb 26 (10:00–10:45am PT), can we align on three items this week:

1) Invite list alignment
- Your target list size + segments (FinServ, Healthcare, RegTech)
- How you want to split responsibilities (who sends to which list)

2) Landing page + UTM plan
- We’ll host the registration page on Redwood and share a NorthPeak-specific UTM link for attribution.
- Proposed base URL: https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/regulated-workloads
- Proposed partner UTMs:
  - utm_source=northpeak
  - utm_medium=partner_webinar
  - utm_campaign=regulated_abm_q1_2026
  - utm_content=invite_v1 (optional)

3) Lead sharing expectations
- Our default: we can share registrants + attendees back to NorthPeak (name, title, company, email) for those who opt in to partner follow-up.
- If you have a standard co-marketing terms blurb you use, send it over and we’ll route it through our marketing ops/legal check.

Noura is running logistics and Ben/Tyler will handle UTM + list ops.

Can you send:
- your proposed invite list criteria (or rough counts)
- confirmation on whether you need daily registrant exports or a post-event report is sufficient

Best,
Camila

Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com


---

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>, Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 12:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Hi Camila,

All makes sense.

Invite list:
- We can mail ~1,200 contacts total
- Split: ~500 FinServ, ~300 Healthcare, ~400 “general regulated/IT risk” (mix of regtech + mid-market)
- Primary personas: Security/GRC, Data Privacy, Platform Eng, and “AI/ML lead” when present

Send plan:
- NorthPeak will send 2 emails (initial + 1 reminder) to our list
- If Redwood can send to your ABM target accounts + any inbound list segments, that would help.

UTMs:
- Happy with the proposed UTMs. We do usually add utm_term for segment tagging (e.g., finserv vs healthcare). Optional.

Lead sharing:
- We need a registrant export mid-week (so our reps can prioritize outreach) and then a final “attended/live vs no-show” export.
- Co-marketing terms: we can use opt-in only. We can send the exact checkbox language we use (attached is our template).

Attachment: NorthPeak_Redwood_Webinar_InviteList_Template_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Maya

Maya Patel
Director, Alliances | NorthPeak Consulting
maya.patel@northpeak-si.com


---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>, Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 7, 2026 at 1:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Jumping in on UTMs + tracking.

We can support:
- Segment tagging via utm_content (simplest) or utm_term (also fine). Our HubSpot capture will store both.

Proposal:
- FinServ: utm_content=invite_finserv_v1
- Healthcare: utm_content=invite_health_v1
- General: utm_content=invite_regulated_v1

We’ll generate 3 NorthPeak links plus a “catch-all.” If you prefer a single link, we can do that too.

Also: do you want unique links per email send (invite vs reminder)? If yes, we’ll add _v2 for the reminder.

Ben

Ben Carter
Growth Marketing | Redwood Inference


---

From: Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Hi Maya,

On lead sharing + exports: we can do both a mid-week registrant export and final attended/no-show export.

A couple operational notes:
- We’ll share only the subset that explicitly opts into partner follow-up (checkbox on the registration form). That includes email/name/title/company.
- We’ll include basic engagement flags in the final export: attended_live (Y/N), watched_recording (Y/N when available), and question_submitted (Y/N).
- We’ll send exports via secure Drive link (not email attachment) unless you prefer SFTP.

Can you confirm which fields your team needs beyond the above (e.g., phone, country)? If we need anything beyond standard fields, we’ll want to keep the form friction low.

Thanks,
Tyler

Tyler Benson
Marketing Ops | Redwood Inference


---

From: Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Feb 8, 2026 at 2:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Hi Maya,

Logistics quick hits:

1) Speaker lineup
- Redwood: Markus Klein (Solutions Eng) + Soojin Lee (PMM) for framing/Q&A
- NorthPeak: Evan (you mentioned he’ll cover “security review playbook” + implementation considerations)

2) Run-of-show (45 min)
- 5 min: why inference is different in regulated environments
- 15 min: reference architecture (Private/VPC boundaries, audit logging, KMS/HSM touchpoints)
- 10 min: live demo snippet (Console: per-route latency/cost + audit log export workflow)
- 10 min: Q&A
- 5 min: next steps (security review package + Private deep-dive)

3) Creative/copy deadlines
- Email copy finalized by Wed 2/11
- Landing page final by Thu 2/12 (so you can start sending early next week)

If you can share your preferred logo usage guidelines and any compliance language you want on the registration page footer, that would help.

Thanks!
Noura

Noura El-Khoury
Events Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>
To: Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 9, 2026 at 10:07 AM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Looks good on structure.

Two requests from our side:
1) Can we ensure the registration form includes “Industry” as a dropdown (FinServ / Healthcare / Other) — helps us route follow-up appropriately.
2) For lead sharing, we only need: name, email, title, company, industry, and country. No phone required.

Logo guidelines attached here (simple — just don’t alter colors).

Evan

Evan Brooks
Principal, Security & Cloud Architecture | NorthPeak Consulting

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northpeak-si.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@northpeak-si.com>, Noura El-Khoury <noura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 9, 2026 at 4:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Regulated Workloads Webinar (Redwood x NorthPeak) — invite list + UTMs + lead sharing

Perfect — thank you.

Decisions + next steps:
- UTMs: Ben will send 3 segment links (FinServ/Healthcare/General) + reminder variants by EOD tomorrow.
- Form fields: we’ll add Industry dropdown + Country (required). Title/company/email required. No phone.
- Lead sharing: opt-in only. Tyler will provide a mid-week export (Wed 2/18) + final attendance report (Fri 2/27).
- Copy: Noura will circulate the final invite + reminder copy draft for approval by Wed 2/11.

Maya — if you can confirm the NorthPeak send dates (targeting week of 2/16?) we’ll align our sends so recipients aren’t getting multiple invitations on the same day.

Thanks all.

Camila

Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference
